question: Can I Print Shipping Labels Directly From WooCommerce?
metaDescription: Yes — through a dedicated carrier or multi-carrier label-printing plugin/service, generating and purchasing labels straight from the order screen.
shortAnswer: Core WooCommerce doesn't print shipping labels natively, but a dedicated carrier-specific or multi-carrier label-printing plugin/service integrates directly with the order screen, letting staff generate, purchase, and print a properly formatted shipping label (often at a discounted commercial rate) for a specific order without leaving the WordPress admin or manually re-entering the address into a separate carrier website.

bodyHtml:
How Label Printing Integrations Work

Once connected to a carrier account, the plugin pulls the order's shipping address and package details directly, generates a compliant label through the carrier's API, and often provides commercial/negotiated rates lower than standard retail postage. The printed label typically also generates a tracking number automatically, which many of these plugins can then feed directly into order tracking and customer notifications.

Benefits Over Manual Label Creation

  • Eliminates re-typing the shipping address into a separate carrier website, reducing both time spent and the risk of a manual entry error.
  • Often unlocks discounted commercial shipping rates not available to someone printing labels through a standard retail carrier interface.
  • Streamlines high-volume fulfillment, particularly valuable for a store processing many orders daily where manual label creation per order doesn't scale.
  • Multi-carrier plugins let a single interface handle labels across several different carriers, useful for a store choosing the cheapest or fastest option per order.

Setting This Up

  1. Choose a label-printing plugin/service supporting the carrier(s) your store actually uses.
  2. Connect the relevant carrier account(s) and configure default package settings.
  3. Generate and print labels directly from the order screen as orders are fulfilled.
